name: Pets
description: Propwash cosmetic pets for supporters (propwash.pets): /pet <name> gives you a baby animal that walks behind you, or a Propwash drone (props spinning) that hovers at your shoulder; /pet off, /pet lists them; /pet code <share code> (propwash.pets.code) makes a Propwash share code your drone. Server-side only; the choice is LuckPerms meta, shared by every server (without LuckPerms: ops get every pet, not remembered).
